data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2016 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 612.805m. Using the gross claims development table the syndicate experienced overall favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 31.8m (a ~5.2% release of opening gross claims), driven by favourable claims development and aided by reinsurance recoveries. The Managing Agent notes net releases from prior accident years in the income statement; separately the syndicate had exposures to a number of 2016 natural catastrophe events (Alberta wildfires, Hurricane Matthew, Louisiana floods) and other incidents (Jubilee field loss offshore Ghana and the Brussels airport terror attack) which the report states did not have a material impact on the syndicate's results.
raw_causal_phrases: 2016 experienced an increase in natural catastrophe events. Notably the Alberta wildfires, Hurricane Matthew, and the Louisiana floods.
None of these events have had a material impact on the Syndicate but the Syndicate did have exposure to both the Jubilee field loss offshore Ghana, and the terror attack on Brussels airport.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 42). The Managing Agent narrative quotes a GBP 40.3m release 'in respect of prior accident years' (page 41) but that figure appears to be a net (after reinsurance) presentation; the gross triangle gives approximately a GBP 31.8m release. Prior-year development value here uses the gross triangle (confidence 0.8). Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Balance Sheet technical provisions prior-year comparative column (page 14).
